summary: Narrow lane beside a wooded bank; nowhere to pull off the lane.

drivers.seclusion: Treed bank on this side, but dwellings 16 m (at 25 m) and 17 m (at 11 m), and homes across the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane is narrow with trees and a steep bank at the edge; no verge, pull-off or tracks, so a van would block it.
drivers.convention: No signs; no parked cars seen along the lane.

sun_shade: Heavy tree cover along the east side; lane partly shaded.
